model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 4 illustrates the mean absolute values before and after gating, showing a comparison between these two states. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20 in intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and also has a linear scale, with a range from 0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2. There are three lines on the graph: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.3, a green dotted line for the "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average of 0.44, and an orange dash-dotted line indicating the "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average of 0.13. The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.9 on the y-axis at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.1 by layer 20. The green dotted line begins at about 0.95 on the y-axis at layer 0 and drops to roughly 0.1 by layer 20. The orange dash-dotted line starts at approximately 0.85 on the y-axis at layer 0 and declines to nearly 0 by layer 20. All three lines exhibit a similar downward trend as the layer number increases from 0 to 20.
model_annotations.Chinese: 图4展示了门控前后的平均绝对值，包括基线值和门控后的值。该图包含两条线，x轴标记为“层”，为数值型，范围从1到8，刻度均匀，间隔为1；y轴标记为“稀疏率”，为数值型，范围从0到1.6，刻度均匀，间隔为0.2。蓝线表示门控前的稀疏率，平均值为0.3，带有圆形标记，实线，在x轴上从1处的1.4下降到8处的0.2，在第2层达到峰值0.45，然后在第3层下降到0.35。绿线表示门控后的稀疏率，平均值为0.44，带有三角形标记，虚线，在x轴上从1处的1.4下降到8处的0.2。红线表示平均门控后的稀疏率，平均值为0.13，带有方形标记，点划线，在x轴上从1处的1.4下降到8处的0.1。蓝线和绿线在整个x轴范围内几乎重叠，而红线则始终低于其他两条线。
model_annotations.English: Figure 4 illustrates the mean absolute values before and after gating, comparing the baseline and post-gating values. The x-axis represents the layer, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20 and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale; the left plot's y-axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2, while the right plot's y-axis ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The left plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average value of 0.2, starting at approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.1 at layer 20; a green dotted line for "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average of 0.44, beginning at about 0.95 at layer 0 and dropping to roughly 0.1 at layer 20; and a red solid line for "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average of 0.13, starting at approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.1 at layer 20. The right plot also contains three lines with the same line styles and colors, representing the same metrics but with different average values: 0.403 for the blue dashed line, 0.126 for the green dotted line, and 0.080 for the red solid line; all three lines start at around 0.7 at layer 0 and decrease to approximately 0.1 at layer 20.
